svg.aria-label: Hole identification map on rear reference photo 3089
svg.title: GH-Wii U002 hole identification map, rear datum view (photo 3089)
svg.desc: Identification aid only. Positions on this image are photo pixels, not millimetres, and carry no dimensional information. This is the datum view: component (rear) side facing the viewer, USB at top, origin at the bottom-left corner of the board's bounding rectangle (battery-connector end). Hole A is the one the project owner measured (diameter 5 mm). Letters B-F are working labels for measurement bookkeeping and match hole-map-3081.svg, which shows the same holes mirrored from the front.
svg.text: IDENTIFICATION AID ONLY - not a measurement, no scale. A = owner-reported 5 mm; B-F working labels (same letters as the front map).
